question: Does the apparent head-private occupied-reader weight structure survive independent orthogonal changes of basis in each head's private 128-dimensional value coordinate?
trigger: The opened grouping result compared flattened maps and top-right singular spaces across heads. Those comparisons assume coordinate alignment between distinct head-local value spaces and are not invariant to the V/O rotation gauge. The result is preserved, but its cross-head grouping interpretation is suspended pending this audit.

frozen_tests.procrustes_similarity: For each pair T_h,T_g, maximize <T_h Q,T_g>/(||T_h||_F||T_g||_F) over orthogonal Q in the private 128-space. The solution is the nuclear norm of T_h^T T_g divided by Frobenius norms.
frozen_tests.context_gram_similarity: Compare G_h=T_h T_h^T through tr(G_h G_g)/(||G_h||_F||G_g||_F), computed without materializing 1152x1152 matrices. This is invariant to right rotations and tests shared context-side computation.
frozen_tests.spectrum_similarity: Cosine between complete per-head singular-value vectors tests whether the maps have the same strength profile even when their subspaces differ.
frozen_tests.projector_ladder: Report context-side projector overlap for ranks 1,2,4,8,16,32,64,128; no rank is selected from outcomes.

predictions.pred_a_authority_formula_rotation_invari: Authorities, direct formula identities, synthetic independent-rotation invariance, finiteness, and zero-forward price pass.
predictions.pred_b_head_maps_remain_private_up_to_or: Median Procrustes similarity is below 0.80 or median context-Gram similarity is below 0.70.
predictions.pred_c_heads_share_only_a_broad_spectral: Median complete singular-spectrum cosine is at least 0.95 while median rank-32 context projector overlap is below 0.60.
predictions.pred_d_no_cross_head_weight_group_is_lic: B passes; therefore the causal representation retains four head-specific transport adapters and groups only their operationally shared downstream response.

opposing_predictions.gauge_hidden_group: Procrustes and context-Gram bars both pass; retract the private-writer interpretation and test a common map plus four head-local orthogonal adapters by held-out interchange.
opposing_predictions.gauge_robust_private: Either similarity bar fails; preserve separate literal writer maps and group only at the downstream response interface.
opposing_predictions.shared_spectrum_only: Spectra agree but context projectors do not; this is common capacity/shape, not common computation.
